description: Pinned production tokenizer artifacts used by tests/reference.rs. Model files are gitignored; `python -I models/fetch.py` downloads them at the recorded revisions and verifies the recorded SHA-256. Hashes and type fields are filled by `python -I models/fetch.py --write-manifest` from the exact downloaded bytes.

artifacts.name: gpt2
artifacts.family: byte-level BPE (GPT-2 regex pre-tokenizer, no normalizer)
artifacts.roundtrip_note: Byte-level BPE decodes back to the exact input bytes in both special-token modes.
artifacts.oracle: tiktoken `gpt2` encoding: literal mode uses disallowed_special=(), recognize mode uses allowed_special='all'. Independent of the Hugging Face tokenizers crate.

artifacts.name: qwen2.5-0.5b
artifacts.family: byte-level BPE (Split regex pre-tokenizer, NFC normalizer)
artifacts.roundtrip_note: The NFC normalizer rewrites non-NFC input before byte-level BPE, so only NFC-normalized text decodes back exactly.
artifacts.oracle: transformers fast tokenizer (Qwen2TokenizerFast via AutoTokenizer) loaded from the pinned tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json. NOT independent: it wraps the same Hugging Face tokenizers Rust backend family as the engine, so this golden checks cross-version agreement only.

artifacts.name: bert-base-uncased
artifacts.family: WordPiece (BERT normalizer: clean text, Chinese chars, lowercase, strip accents)
artifacts.roundtrip_note: Lowercasing, accent stripping, and [UNK] replacement are lossy; no exact decode round trip exists.
artifacts.oracle: transformers slow BertTokenizer (pure-Python port of Google's original tokenization.py BasicTokenizer + WordpieceTokenizer) loaded from the pinned vocab.txt with do_lower_case=True. Independent of the Hugging Face tokenizers crate.

artifacts.name: xlm-roberta-base
artifacts.roundtrip_note: The charsmap normalizer and Metaspace whitespace handling are lossy; no exact decode round trip exists.
artifacts.oracle: Google sentencepiece with the original sentencepiece.bpe.model for literal mode (spm id k>=3 maps to k+1, spm <unk>=0 maps to 3, matching the fairseq offset); transformers slow XLMRobertaTokenizer (sentencepiece-backed) for recognize mode and add_special_tokens. Independent of the Hugging Face tokenizers crate.

artifacts.name: cl100k_base
artifacts.family: byte-level BPE (cl100k regex pre-tokenizer, no normalizer)
artifacts.license: MIT (OpenAI tiktoken encoding; Hugging Face conversion by Xenova)
artifacts.roundtrip_note: Byte-level BPE decodes back to the exact input bytes in both special-token modes.
artifacts.oracle: tiktoken `cl100k_base` encoding with the artifact's added special tokens: literal mode uses disallowed_special=(), recognize mode allowed_special="all".

artifacts.license: MIT (OpenAI tiktoken encoding; Hugging Face conversion by Xenova)

artifacts.oracle: tiktoken `o200k_base` encoding with the artifact's added special tokens: literal mode uses disallowed_special=(), recognize mode allowed_special="all".
